formula: MDE(bar) = (bar + 0.8416) x SE, SE = ann_excess / t from the artifact (Lens 2 spec docs/research/2026-11-04-lens2-sensitivity-spec.md §4 column 11); bar = 3 and 2; required IR = MDE / artifact tracking_error_pct; years-to-detect (iid scenario only) = ((bar + 0.8416) x sigma / X)^2; target: strategy total return = 2 x SPY total return over the same window, target CAGR = (1 + 2R)^(1/years) - 1, required gap = target CAGR - SPY CAGR
notes: Per-row SE uses one method per row (the artifact's own). MDE is on the arithmetic annualized mean excess, not on the CAGR gap; the target gap is a CAGR (geometric) gap, so comparisons are approximate (arithmetic excess ~ CAGR gap + half the variance difference). Years-to-detect rows are an iid approximation with tracking error as sigma and are not per-row MDEs. SPY total return from yfinance auto-adjusted closes (dividend-adjusted), not from the DB tape (Lens 1 adjustment seams). Generated by Lens 9 on 2026-11-04.
